name: Message Never Sent
hint: When a sprite waits for a message to receive, you have to make sure, that it is sent.
instruction: Send the message at the intended position.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when [space v] key pressed
say [Hello] for (2) seconds

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when [space v] key pressed
say [Hello] for (2) seconds
broadcast [startToFly v] and wait :: #007000 //⇦  👍

examples.label: Error 2
examples.scratchblocks:
when I receive [startToFly v] :: #ff0000 // ⇦  🐛
glide (1) secs to [random position v]

examples.label: Possible Solution 2
examples.scratchblocks:
when I receive [startToFly v] :: #007000 // ⇦  👍
glide (1) secs to [random position v]
